what: Plan treats --description-text as the prompt payload but does not specify any required prompt source flag
scenario_or_breakage: launch-review.sh requires exactly one of --prompt, --prompt-file, or --agent-file for Codex/Cursor, and launch-claude-review.sh requires the same for Claude; --description-text alone is only auxiliary render context and every tier can exit 2 before producing a patch
suggested_fix: Change the tier call sketch to pass the composed prompt as --prompt-file "$prompt_file" or --prompt "$prompt"; do not rely on --description-text as the prompt source

what: Codex and Cursor launcher call sketch omits required --timeout
scenario_or_breakage: launch-review.sh rejects both Codex and Cursor calls without --timeout, so the waterfall would skip viable external tiers with launcher exit 2 instead of evaluating their patches
suggested_fix: Include --timeout "$timeout" on both launch-review.sh --tool codex and launch-review.sh --tool cursor calls; Claude may also receive it to honor the plan's per-tier timeout option
